methodology_note: Real coach-per-edition data researched for the 2018 FIFA World Cup (Russia) specifically, to extend the Argumental coach-cycle solar-revolution signal backtest to a second real past edition. Keyed by team name exactly as it appears in engine.backtest's parsed historical matches (post-alias). Each entry is the coach who actually led the team AT the 2018 tournament and the date/time/venue of THEIR first match in charge of that continuous tenure (which can predate 2018 by years for long-serving coaches, e.g. Löw since 2006). All 32 teams had a genuinely sourced kickoff time this edition, unlike 2022 (which excluded 3 of 32) -- no team was included on a guessed or placeholder time.
